subject: Important Update: Your Flight Reservation
body: Dear Customer, We would like to inform you that there has been a change in your flight reservation. Your departure time has been rescheduled to 2 hours earlier due to unforeseen circumstances. Please check your updated itinerary for more details. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. If you have any questions, feel free to contact our customer service team. Thank you for choosing our airline. Best regards, Flight Reservations Team
